Package org.smtlib.impl

Class Response

java.lang.Object
org.smtlib.impl.Response
public abstract class Response extends Object
This class holds subclasses that are implementations of the various IResponse interfaces. It is never itself instantiated -- only its nested classes and the constants below are used.
